title: appLookup v1
description: Dock to Harbor.Shell, on the control channel: a running app the dock hasn't had named yet (docs/adr/0010). The Shell answers with appInfo for the same id. Sent once per app the dock sees, and again for every live one after a reconnect. Lengths count Unicode characters (code points); control characters are not allowed. Any change to this message bumps v.

id.description: The dock's number for the app: one per app identity, never reused for another app.

aumid.description: The app's AppUserModelID (the window's, or its package's), or null if it has none.

exe.description: The full path of the app's executable, or null if the dock couldn't read it.

window.description: One of the app's windows (its HWND), so the Shell can read the window's relaunch name and icon; null if none.
